Cross-origin requests: browsers on the allowed origins may call the API, and their preflight requests are answered.

```esquadro
blueprint cors
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [http](../http/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `origins` | list | `[]` | Origins browsers may call the API from, or ["*"] for any; none lets no origin in. &lt;APP>_CORS_ORIGINS, comma separated, overrides it. |

```esquadro
blueprint cors {
  origins ["value"]
}
```
